jobs.name: main_trading_bot
jobs.description: Run main trading bot every weekday at 9 AM

jobs.name: risk_monitoring
jobs.command: python -c "from risk_management import RiskManager; rm = RiskManager(); rm.generate_daily_report()"

jobs.name: daily_report
jobs.command: python -c "from notifications import NotificationManager; nm = NotificationManager(); import asyncio; asyncio.run(nm.send_daily_summary())"
jobs.description: Send daily trading summary at 6 PM

jobs.name: system_health_check
jobs.command: python -c "import os, json; from datetime import datetime; status = {'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(), 'status': 'healthy', 'uptime': os.path.getsize('logs/trade_detections.log') if os.path.exists('logs/trade_detections.log') else 0}; open('system_health.json', 'w').write(json.dumps(status, indent=2))"

jobs.name: log_cleanup
jobs.command: python -c "import os, glob, time; [os.remove(f) for f in glob.glob('logs/**/*.log', recursive=True) if os.path.getmtime(f) < time.time() - 7*24*3600]"
jobs.description: Clean up old log files weekly at 2 AM Sunday

jobs.name: backup_trades
jobs.command: python -c "import shutil, datetime; shutil.copy2('logs/trades.csv', f'backups/trades_{datetime.date.today().strftime(\"%Y%m%d\")}.csv') if os.path.exists('logs/trades.csv') else None"
jobs.description: Backup trade data daily at 1 AM
